reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Jack Clark, head coach of the University of California Varsity Rugby team.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Jack Clark, head coach of the University of California Varsity Rugby team. Jack has one of the highest winning percentages not only at the collegiate level but in sports history. That includes a 98 game winning streak from 1990 to 1996 and a 115 game winning streak from 2004 to 2009.

key_points.text: Jack has one of the highest winning percentages not only at the collegiate level but in sports history.
In our conversation, we dive into how Jack builds high-performing teams, the shared vocabulary he creates across his organization.
Please enjoy this conversation with Jack Clark.
